data.one_liner: A modern Google-style animated bottom navigation bar widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar with animated transitions, backgrounds, and shadows for each tab button. It follows the Cuberto UI/UX design pattern.
use_when: You want a Google-style animated bottom navigation bar
You need customizable tab buttons with individual styling, padding, and animations
avoid_when: You need native platform navigation patterns (like standard Material BottomNavigationBar or CupertinoTabBar)
You require complex navigation handling like nested routing (use a router package instead)
strengths: Smooth built-in tab animations and customizable curves
Extensive styling options for individual tabs and global bar configuration
weaknesses: Limited to a specific navigation bar design aesthetic
Not tied into state-based navigation routers automatically
